title: Apty Pricing: Plans, Costs and Contract Ranges (2026)
summary: Apty pricing depends on your plan, user count, and add-ons, so you'll understand what factors to adjust to manage your actual costs.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Does Apty have a free plan or free trial?


We haven't confirmed either one, so assume neither until Apty's pricing page or a sales rep says so in writing. If you budget around a trial that doesn't exist, the first real charge lands before you've tested the tool on your own screens.


Ask for a trial period or a pilot, and ask what it covers, because a trial that locks the features you need tells you little about the paid plan.


### Is Apty priced per user or per application?


Pin down the charging unit first; Apty lists $9,500 per application. Read the pricing page for the unit before you read the price.


If it counts users, your bill grows with headcount, and a rollout to a whole company costs far more than a pilot with one team. If it counts applications, the bill grows each time you add another system you want guidance on.


A plan can also mix the two, with a base fee plus a per-unit charge. Rebuild your number using the unit Apty states, and write down the date you checked it.


### Can you negotiate Apty's price at renewal?


Often, yes, but nothing we've seen says Apty guarantees it, and the best time to negotiate is before you sign. A renewal price is just another number the vendor sets, and an increase you didn't plan for is the second invoice problem again.


Ask for the renewal terms while you're still deciding. A written cap on how much the price can rise is worth more than a discount you're promised later.


If you're a year in and the quote has jumped, you still have room to push back, but less of it.


### Does Apty charge for implementation?


We can't say whether implementation is included, and you shouldn't assume it's. Setup, training and help building the first guided flows can each show up as their own line, or be folded into the subscription.


Ask for the quote itemized, with onboarding as a separate row. If it's bundled, get that stated in the contract, so a "free" setup doesn't turn into a paid services request halfway through the rollout.


### How often does Apty change its pricing?


We found no published schedule, so treat any price you see as true only on the day you saw it. Plans, limits and add-ons can change without notice, and a figure from last quarter's screenshot may no longer match what you're quoted.


Save the pricing page with the date, compare it to the quote line by line, and ask the rep to explain any difference before you sign.
